modules.title: First English Sentences
modules.skillFocus: Say one complete English sentence without fear.
modules.challenge: Short greetings, names, and polite words.
modules.overview: Start with greetings, your name, polite words, and simple confidence-building lines.

modules.title: Home And Family
modules.skillFocus: Talk about people, home routines, and small needs.
modules.challenge: Add family words, time words, and simple requests.
modules.overview: Practice talking about family, daily routines, and simple needs at home.

modules.title: Shopping And Directions
modules.skillFocus: Ask practical questions outside the home.
modules.challenge: Use question order for price, place, and transport.
modules.overview: Learn useful lines for prices, shops, local transport, and asking where something is.

modules.title: Community Errands
modules.skillFocus: Explain basic needs to service people.
modules.challenge: Describe symptoms, repairs, bank help, and society issues.
modules.overview: Practice simple English for the clinic, chemist, society office, bank, and repair calls.

modules.title: Daily Conversations
modules.skillFocus: Hold a short back-and-forth conversation.
modules.challenge: Combine greeting, reason, timing, and one follow-up.
modules.overview: Build slightly longer conversations for phone calls, neighbors, appointments, and explaining small problems.

modules.title: Everyday Problem Solving
modules.skillFocus: Explain changes, delays, and problems clearly.
modules.challenge: Use because, before, after, and polite follow-up.
modules.overview: Move into longer, more natural English for planning, explaining delays, community issues, and school meetings.

modules.title: Confident Community Conversations
modules.skillFocus: Speak in connected sentences with confidence.
modules.challenge: Disagree politely, clarify misunderstandings, and summarize.
modules.overview: Practice connected English for polite disagreement, preferences, misunderstandings, follow-up questions, and problem summaries.

modules.title: Nuanced Home Conversations
modules.skillFocus: Explain household priorities, tradeoffs, and responsibilities in connected English.
modules.challenge: Use contrast, reasons, and polite suggestions without sounding abrupt.
modules.overview: Practice longer home conversations about planning, budgets, guests, and shared responsibilities.

modules.title: Health And Care Conversations
modules.skillFocus: Describe health concerns, medicine routines, and care needs with enough detail.
modules.challenge: Use time, frequency, symptoms, and follow-up questions clearly.
modules.overview: Build confidence for doctor visits, elder care, medicine timing, and emotional wellbeing conversations.

modules.title: School And Child Growth
modules.skillFocus: Speak with teachers about progress, support, routines, and concerns.
modules.challenge: Ask specific questions and summarize action plans.
modules.overview: Practice parent-teacher conversations that go beyond one-line requests.

modules.title: Money, Documents, And Services
modules.skillFocus: Clarify charges, compare options, and request written confirmation.
modules.challenge: Stay polite while being precise about money, documents, and service mistakes.
modules.overview: Practice confident English for bank, bills, documents, and service-provider conversations.

modules.title: Digital Everyday Life
modules.skillFocus: Explain app, payment, delivery, and privacy issues clearly.
modules.challenge: Use sequence words and exact details without panic.
modules.overview: Practice digital-life English for apps, orders, payments, delivery instructions, and safety.

modules.title: Personal Goals And Confidence
modules.skillFocus: Talk about your goals, experience, strengths, and practice plans.
modules.challenge: Use past experience and future plans in natural connected speech.
modules.overview: Build self-expression for learning, interviews, community work, and everyday confidence.

modules.title: Community Leadership
modules.skillFocus: Lead calm discussions, handle complaints, and summarize group actions.
modules.challenge: Balance empathy, clarity, and decisions in one conversation.
modules.overview: Practice speaking as a confident participant in housing society or neighborhood conversations.

modules.title: Travel And Public Spaces
modules.skillFocus: Ask for help, explain problems, and request changes while travelling.
modules.challenge: Use polite urgency without losing clarity.
modules.overview: Practice practical English for stations, hotels, delays, lost items, and accessibility support.

modules.title: Opinions And Stories
modules.skillFocus: Tell short stories, compare options, and give reasons for your opinion.
modules.challenge: Connect ideas with because, although, while, and so.
modules.overview: Move from practical sentences into more personal, expressive English.

modules.title: Advanced Everyday Fluency
modules.skillFocus: Handle multi-step conversations with confidence and closure.
modules.challenge: Combine problem, reason, request, instruction, and closing politely.
modules.overview: Practice longer everyday English that feels calm, organized, and natural.

modules.title: Advanced Home Decisions
modules.skillFocus: Discuss sensitive home decisions with reasons, boundaries, and calm confidence.
modules.challenge: Balance directness and respect in longer family conversations.
modules.overview: Practice mature household conversations about priorities, budgets, boundaries, and fairness.

modules.title: Healthcare Advocacy
modules.skillFocus: Explain health patterns, ask careful questions, and speak up for care needs.
modules.challenge: Use detail without sounding confused or aggressive.
modules.overview: Practice advanced clinic and family-care conversations where clarity matters.

modules.title: Work, Skills, And Income
modules.skillFocus: Talk about skills, flexible work, home business, and customer issues.
modules.challenge: Sound confident while explaining experience and constraints.
modules.overview: Build speaking confidence for earning opportunities, interviews, and small-business conversations.

modules.title: Education Advocacy
modules.skillFocus: Discuss learning needs, school action plans, and child wellbeing.
modules.challenge: Ask focused questions and request next steps clearly.
modules.overview: Practice deeper parent-school conversations with practical follow-up.

modules.title: Civic And Services
modules.skillFocus: Follow up on official complaints, timelines, and unresolved service issues.
modules.challenge: Stay firm, factual, and polite over multiple turns.
modules.overview: Practice English for formal service follow-up, civic issues, and escalation.

modules.title: Financial Confidence
modules.skillFocus: Ask careful money questions and explain financial choices.
modules.challenge: Compare options, refuse pressure, and request clarity.
modules.overview: Practice English for loans, insurance, savings, charges, and financial boundaries.

modules.title: Conflict And Boundaries
modules.skillFocus: Handle pressure, disagreement, and misunderstandings with calm boundaries.
modules.challenge: Use respectful but firm English in emotional conversations.
modules.overview: Practice saying no, disagreeing, repairing misunderstandings, and asking for support.

modules.title: Storytelling And Opinions
modules.skillFocus: Tell personal stories and explain opinions with balance.
modules.challenge: Connect past, present, reasons, and reflection naturally.
modules.overview: Move into expressive English for stories, opinions, proud moments, and comparisons.

modules.title: Public Speaking And Groups
modules.skillFocus: Speak in small groups with structure, support, and closure.
modules.challenge: Organize your point while acknowledging other people.
modules.overview: Practice group discussion English for meetings, committees, and community decisions.

modules.title: Advanced Fluency Mix
modules.skillFocus: Handle complex, multi-step conversations with confidence.
modules.challenge: Use conditions, sequence, clarification, and reflection in one flow.
modules.overview: Practice the most advanced everyday speaking patterns in the current curriculum.

modules.title: Professional Communication
modules.skillFocus: Speak about work, interviews, schedules, and feedback with steady confidence.
modules.challenge: Sound clear and respectful while discussing professional responsibilities.
modules.overview: Practice practical English for job conversations, interviews, workplace feedback, and follow-up.

modules.title: Small Business Customer Talk
modules.skillFocus: Explain products, prices, delays, and customer needs in natural English.
modules.challenge: Stay warm and professional while handling questions or complaints.
modules.overview: Build English for home businesses, customer calls, reviews, and order updates.

modules.title: Digital Safety And Support
modules.skillFocus: Explain online safety problems and ask for digital support clearly.
modules.challenge: Use exact details without sharing private information unnecessarily.
modules.overview: Practice English for suspicious messages, account recovery, payments, privacy, and forms.

modules.title: Family Wellbeing Discussions
modules.skillFocus: Discuss emotional needs, shared care, routines, and encouragement at home.
modules.challenge: Use calm, specific English in sensitive family conversations.
modules.overview: Practice deeper family conversations about pressure, care plans, boundaries, health, and confidence.

modules.title: Official And Legal Help
modules.skillFocus: Ask for document, receipt, application, and next-step guidance with clarity.
modules.challenge: Stay factual and polite when dealing with formal processes.
modules.overview: Practice English for government offices, document checks, fees, forms, and legal guidance.

modules.title: Travel Problem Solving Plus
modules.skillFocus: Handle travel changes, delays, local help, and safety needs with clear requests.
modules.challenge: Explain urgency without sounding panicked.
modules.overview: Practice advanced travel English for missed connections, safe rides, hotel guidance, luggage, and trip changes.

modules.title: Community Event Planning
modules.skillFocus: Plan group events, assign tasks, request support, and close with appreciation.
modules.challenge: Organize many details while keeping the tone friendly.
modules.overview: Practice English for community programs, volunteer coordination, sponsors, changes, and thanks.

modules.title: Deep Conversation Skills
modules.skillFocus: Share values, ask sensitive questions, listen well, and repair small mistakes.
modules.challenge: Use emotionally careful English without becoming vague.
modules.overview: Practice thoughtful English for empathy, gratitude, sensitive questions, and conversational repair.

modules.title: Home Learning And Technology
modules.skillFocus: Talk about online classes, device sharing, study routines, and learning tools.
modules.challenge: Give practical instructions and comparisons without sounding harsh.
modules.overview: Practice English for home study, children, learning apps, screen breaks, and reminders.

modules.title: Confident Fluency Challenges
modules.skillFocus: Handle longer, less predictable conversations with calm structure.
modules.challenge: Think, answer, summarize, and set next goals while speaking English.
modules.overview: Practice advanced fluency for nervous moments, complex choices, long summaries, unexpected questions, and next goals.

lessons.title: Say Hello And Introduce Yourself
lessons.overview: You will practice greeting someone, saying your name, and using one polite sentence with confidence.
skipOverview: Simple greetings like hello and good morning
Saying your name using 'My name is...'
One polite sentence: 'Nice to meet you'

activities.prompt: Listen, read, and tap Meaning if you want help.

sentence.targetText: Hello, good morning.

support.hi-Deva: नमस्ते, सुप्रभात।
support.hi-Latn: Namaste, good morning.

notes.hi-Deva: किसी से बात शुरू करने के लिए यह आसान और विनम्र वाक्य है।
notes.hi-Latn: Kisi se baat shuru karne ke liye yeh easy aur polite sentence hai.

activities.prompt: Now introduce yourself.

sentence.targetText: My name is Kavita.

support.hi-Deva: मेरा नाम कविता है।
support.hi-Latn: Mera naam Kavita hai.

activities.prompt: Which sentence is better for introducing yourself?
options: My name is Kavita.
Name my Kavita.
I Kavita name.
activities.answer: My name is Kavita.

explanation.hi-Deva: 'My name is...' अपना नाम बताने का सही और आसान तरीका है।
explanation.hi-Latn: 'My name is...' apna naam batane ka sahi aur easy tareeka hai.

activities.prompt: Arrange the words to make a friendly sentence.

explanation.hi-Deva: English में अभिवादन के बाद 'Nice to meet you' एक पूरा और विनम्र वाक्य है।
explanation.hi-Latn: English mein greeting ke baad 'Nice to meet you' ek complete aur polite sentence hai.

activities.prompt: Speak this sentence slowly and clearly.

sentence.targetText: Nice to meet you.

support.hi-Deva: आपसे मिलकर अच्छा लगा।
support.hi-Latn: Aapse milkar achha laga.

lessons.title: Ask For Help Politely
lessons.overview: You will practice asking for help and saying please in a simple, respectful way.
skipOverview: Saying 'I do not understand' without fear

activities.prompt: Use this when you need help.

sentence.targetText: Can you help me, please?

support.hi-Deva: क्या आप मेरी मदद कर सकते हैं, कृपया?
support.hi-Latn: Kya aap meri madad kar sakte hain, please?

activities.prompt: Which sentence is polite and correct?
options: Can you help me, please?
You help me now.
Help my please.
activities.answer: Can you help me, please?

explanation.hi-Deva: 'Can you...' और 'please' मिलकर वाक्य को विनम्र बनाते हैं।
explanation.hi-Latn: 'Can you...' aur 'please' sentence ko polite banate hain.

activities.prompt: Put these words in a natural question order.

explanation.hi-Deva: 'I do not...' बोलने से वाक्य साफ और सही बनता है।
explanation.hi-Latn: 'I do not...' bolne se sentence clear aur correct banta hai.

activities.prompt: Say this when something is confusing.

sentence.targetText: I do not understand.

support.hi-Deva: मुझे समझ नहीं आया।
support.hi-Latn: Mujhe samajh nahi aaya.

lessons.title: Talk About Your Family
lessons.overview: You will practice simple sentences about family members and daily routines at home.
skipOverview: Saying who is in your family

activities.prompt: Start with a simple family sentence.

sentence.targetText: I have two children.

support.hi-Deva: मेरे दो बच्चे हैं।
support.hi-Latn: Mere do bachche hain.

activities.prompt: Talk about your routine.

sentence.targetText: I cook breakfast in the morning.

support.hi-Deva: मैं सुबह नाश्ता बनाती हूँ।
support.hi-Latn: Main subah nashta banati hoon.

activities.prompt: Which sentence sounds natural?
options: I cook breakfast in the morning.
I cooking breakfast morning.
Breakfast I cook morning.
activities.answer: I cook breakfast in the morning.

explanation.hi-Deva: Simple present में 'I cook...' रोज़ की आदत के लिए सही है।
explanation.hi-Latn: Simple present mein 'I cook...' daily habit ke liye sahi hai.

activities.prompt: Fill the blank to complete the daily routine sentence.
activities.sentenceEnd: breakfast in the morning.
options: cook
cooks
cooking
activities.answer: cook

explanation.hi-Deva: 'I' के साथ रोज़ की आदत बताने के लिए simple verb आता है: 'I cook'।
explanation.hi-Latn: 'I' ke saath daily habit batane ke liye simple verb aata hai: 'I cook'.

activities.prompt: Arrange the words for a simple family sentence.

explanation.hi-Deva: English में अक्सर पहले व्यक्ति या चीज़ आती है, फिर 'is', फिर उसका वर्णन।
explanation.hi-Latn: English mein aksar pehle person ya thing aata hai, phir 'is', phir uska description.

activities.prompt: Say this slowly.

sentence.targetText: My family is small.

support.hi-Deva: मेरा परिवार छोटा है।
support.hi-Latn: Mera parivaar chhota hai.

lessons.title: Ask For Things At Home
lessons.overview: You will practice asking for simple things at home using short and polite English.
skipOverview: Requesting help with one small task

activities.prompt: Ask for water in a simple way.

sentence.targetText: Please give me some water.

support.hi-Deva: कृपया मुझे थोड़ा पानी दीजिए।
support.hi-Latn: Please mujhe thoda paani dijiye.

activities.prompt: Use this when something is over.

sentence.targetText: The milk is finished.

support.hi-Deva: दूध खत्म हो गया है।
support.hi-Latn: Doodh khatam ho gaya hai.

activities.prompt: Choose the home item that completes the sentence.
activities.sentenceEnd: is finished.
options: milk
give
please
activities.answer: milk

explanation.hi-Deva: 'The milk is finished' में 'milk' चीज़ का नाम है। 'is finished' बताता है कि वह खत्म हो गया है।
explanation.hi-Latn: 'The milk is finished' mein 'milk' cheez ka naam hai. 'is finished' batata hai ki woh khatam ho gaya hai.

activities.prompt: Arrange the request in a polite order.

explanation.hi-Deva: 'Please' को शुरू में रखने से अनुरोध तुरंत विनम्र लगता है।
explanation.hi-Latn: 'Please' ko start mein rakhne se request turant polite lagti hai.

activities.prompt: Ask for a little help.

sentence.targetText: Can you help me in the kitchen?

support.hi-Deva: क्या आप रसोई में मेरी मदद कर सकते हैं?
support.hi-Latn: Kya aap rasoi mein meri madad kar sakte hain?

lessons.title: Welcome A Guest
lessons.overview: You will practice simple English for welcoming a guest and offering tea or water.

activities.prompt: Say this when a guest comes home.

sentence.targetText: Please come in.

support.hi-Deva: कृपया अंदर आइए।
support.hi-Latn: Please andar aaiye.

activities.prompt: Offer tea politely.

sentence.targetText: Would you like some tea?

support.hi-Deva: क्या आप थोड़ी चाय लेना चाहेंगे?
support.hi-Latn: Kya aap thodi chai lena chahenge?

activities.prompt: Ask someone to sit.

sentence.targetText: Please sit here.

support.hi-Deva: कृपया यहाँ बैठिए।
support.hi-Latn: Please yahan baithiye.

activities.prompt: Complete the polite offer.
activities.sentenceEnd: tea?
options: some
is
bring
activities.answer: some

explanation.hi-Deva: खाने-पीने की चीज़ offer करते समय 'some tea' बहुत natural और polite लगता है।
explanation.hi-Latn: Khaane-peene ki cheez offer karte time 'some tea' bahut natural aur polite lagta hai.

activities.prompt: Say this in a warm voice.

sentence.targetText: I will bring water.

support.hi-Deva: मैं पानी लेकर आती हूँ।
support.hi-Latn: Main paani lekar aati hoon.

lessons.title: Ask About A Child's Day
lessons.overview: You will practice easy family sentences for homework, school, and a child's routine.

activities.prompt: Ask this after school.

sentence.targetText: How was school today?

support.hi-Deva: आज स्कूल कैसा था?
support.hi-Latn: Aaj school kaisa tha?

activities.prompt: Ask about homework.

sentence.targetText: Do you have homework?

support.hi-Deva: क्या तुम्हें होमवर्क मिला है?
support.hi-Latn: Kya tumhe homework mila hai?

activities.prompt: Give a calm reminder.

sentence.targetText: Please finish your homework first.

support.hi-Deva: कृपया पहले अपना होमवर्क पूरा करो।
support.hi-Latn: Please pehle apna homework poora karo.

activities.prompt: Say this with care.

sentence.targetText: I am proud of you.

support.hi-Deva: मुझे तुम पर गर्व है।
support.hi-Latn: Mujhe tum par garv hai.

lessons.title: Ask Price While Shopping
lessons.overview: You will practice asking the price, quantity, and location of an item at a shop.

activities.prompt: Use this at a shop.

sentence.targetText: How much is this?

support.hi-Deva: यह कितने का है?
support.hi-Latn: Yeh kitne ka hai?

activities.prompt: Ask for one item politely.

sentence.targetText: Please give me one packet.

support.hi-Deva: कृपया मुझे एक पैकेट दीजिए।
support.hi-Latn: Please mujhe ek packet dijiye.

activities.prompt: Fill the blank to ask for one packet.
activities.sentenceEnd: packet.
options: one
how
is
activities.answer: one

explanation.hi-Deva: 'one packet' quantity बताता है। दुकान पर चीज़ मांगते समय यह साफ और आसान है।
explanation.hi-Latn: 'one packet' quantity batata hai. Dukaan par cheez mangte time yeh clear aur easy hai.

activities.prompt: Which sentence should you use to ask price?
options: How much is this?
How many this price?
This much how?
activities.answer: How much is this?

explanation.hi-Deva: कीमत पूछने के लिए 'How much is this?' सबसे आसान वाक्य है।
explanation.hi-Latn: Price poochne ke liye 'How much is this?' sabse easy sentence hai.

activities.prompt: Arrange the words to ask the price.

explanation.hi-Deva: कीमत पूछते समय 'How much' साथ आता है, फिर 'is this?'।
explanation.hi-Latn: Price poochte time 'How much' saath aata hai, phir 'is this?'.

activities.prompt: Say this when you need directions in a shop.

sentence.targetText: Where is the milk?

support.hi-Deva: दूध कहाँ है?
support.hi-Latn: Doodh kahan hai?

lessons.title: Take Local Transport
lessons.overview: You will practice short English sentences for asking the way and stopping nearby.
skipOverview: Saying where you want to go
Asking if the place is near

activities.prompt: Tell the driver your place.

sentence.targetText: I want to go to the market.

support.hi-Deva: मुझे बाज़ार जाना है।
support.hi-Latn: Mujhe bazaar jana hai.

activities.prompt: Ask if the place is close.

sentence.targetText: Is it near?

support.hi-Deva: क्या यह पास है?
support.hi-Latn: Kya yeh paas hai?

activities.prompt: Use this when you reach your stop.

sentence.targetText: Please stop here.

support.hi-Deva: कृपया यहाँ रोकिए।
support.hi-Latn: Please yahan rokiye.

lessons.title: Visit A Clinic Or Chemist
lessons.overview: You will practice simple English for telling symptoms and asking about medicine.
skipOverview: Checking if medicine is for children or adults

activities.prompt: Use this at a clinic.

sentence.targetText: My son has fever.

support.hi-Deva: मेरे बेटे को बुखार है।
support.hi-Latn: Mere bete ko bukhar hai.

notes.hi-Deva: भारत में लोग अक्सर 'has fever' बोलते हैं। यह साफ और समझने में आसान है।
notes.hi-Latn: India mein log aksar 'has fever' bolte hain. Yeh clear aur easy to understand hai.

activities.prompt: Ask about medicine clearly.

sentence.targetText: How should I give this medicine?

support.hi-Deva: मुझे यह दवा कैसे देनी चाहिए?
support.hi-Latn: Mujhe yeh dawa kaise deni chahiye?

activities.prompt: Which sentence is best at the chemist?
options: How should I give this medicine?
Medicine how give?
This medicine giving how?
activities.answer: How should I give this medicine?

explanation.hi-Deva: 'How should I...' सलाह पूछने का सही और विनम्र तरीका है।
explanation.hi-Latn: 'How should I...' advice poochne ka sahi aur polite tareeka hai.

activities.prompt: Complete the symptom sentence.
options: fever
tablet
chemist
activities.answer: fever

explanation.hi-Deva: 'has fever' बीमारी या symptom बताने के लिए natural है।
explanation.hi-Latn: 'has fever' illness ya symptom batane ke liye natural hai.

activities.prompt: Ask this slowly at the medicine counter.

sentence.targetText: Is this medicine for children?

support.hi-Deva: क्या यह दवा बच्चों के लिए है?
support.hi-Latn: Kya yeh dawa bachchon ke liye hai?

lessons.title: Talk At The Society Office
lessons.overview: You will practice asking society office staff about bills, water, and simple home issues.

activities.prompt: Ask about your bill.

sentence.targetText: Is my maintenance bill due?

support.hi-Deva: क्या मेरा मेंटेनेंस बिल बाकी है?
support.hi-Latn: Kya mera maintenance bill baaki hai?

activities.prompt: Report a water problem.

sentence.targetText: There is no water at home.

support.hi-Deva: घर में पानी नहीं है।
support.hi-Latn: Ghar mein paani nahi hai.

activities.prompt: Choose the correct problem word.
activities.sentenceEnd: at home.
options: water
due
visit
activities.answer: water

explanation.hi-Deva: 'There is no water' से समस्या साफ बताई जाती है।
explanation.hi-Latn: 'There is no water' se problem clear batayi jaati hai.

activities.prompt: Arrange the request in a polite order.

explanation.hi-Deva: 'Please send someone today' society office में मदद मांगने का सरल तरीका है।
explanation.hi-Latn: 'Please send someone today' society office mein help mangne ka simple tareeka hai.

activities.prompt: Request help politely.

sentence.targetText: Please send someone today.

support.hi-Deva: कृपया आज किसी को भेज दीजिए।
support.hi-Latn: Please aaj kisi ko bhej dijiye.

lessons.title: Ask For Bank Or ATM Help
lessons.overview: You will practice simple English for bank counters, ATM problems, and form help.
skipOverview: Saying the ATM is not working

activities.prompt: Ask where to go in the bank.

sentence.targetText: Which counter is for cash deposit?

support.hi-Deva: कैश जमा करने के लिए कौन सा काउंटर है?
support.hi-Latn: Cash jama karne ke liye kaun sa counter hai?

activities.prompt: Use this for an ATM problem.

sentence.targetText: The ATM is not working.

support.hi-Deva: एटीएम काम नहीं कर रहा है।
support.hi-Latn: ATM kaam nahi kar raha hai.

activities.prompt: Which sentence clearly explains the ATM problem?
options: The ATM is not working.
ATM no work.
ATM is no working.
activities.answer: The ATM is not working.

explanation.hi-Deva: 'is not working' मशीन या service की समस्या बताने के लिए सही है।
